notes: This paper (Procházka 2015) is a 3-year trial (2012-2014) on soybean cv. Merlin in Czech Republic comparing HFA products (Lexin, Lignohumate B), brassinosteroid, and a complete seed treatment vs untreated control. The GT has 6 rows representing year-specific yield observations (3 years × 2 products: Lexin and Lignohumate B), with ctrl_means ~0.251-0.334 (likely t/ha). The JSON extracted 3-year averaged yield values (n=9, ctrl=2850 kg/ha ≈ 2.85 t/ha), so the absolute means differ substantially from the per-year GT values. All 6 GT rows are matched (confidence=medium) because the JSON only provides multi-year averages rather than per-year data, causing effect size discrepancies — e.g., for Lignohumate B the JSON shows only +1.75% averaged over 3 years while GT year-specific effects range from +7.0% to +15.5%. The JSON extracted 4 treatments including Brassinosteroid (json_idx 18) and Complete seed treatment (json_idx 19) which have no corresponding GT pairs. Non-yield outcomes (field emergence, stand density, stand height, pod height) account for 16 unmatched JSON observations.
